lines.en: I follow a few steps behind you

lines.zh: 你走我也走，你停我也停
lines.en: You walk, I walk; you stop, I stop

lines.zh: 我用脚尖落地，没有声音
lines.en: I land on my toes, silent

lines.zh: 洞道里我只剩一个影子
lines.en: In the tunnel I am only a shadow

lines.zh: 我沿着你火把照不到的地方走
lines.en: I walk where your torch does not reach

lines.zh: 我保持着四五格的间距
lines.en: I keep four or five blocks between us
I stop before you turn around

lines.zh: 我的脚步贴着你的脚步
lines.en: My steps echo your steps
I walk around the puddles you left

lines.zh: 我在你背后换了个方向
lines.en: I change direction behind your back

lines.zh: 洞里的回声替我遮住声音
lines.en: The cave echo hides my sound
I close in little by little

lines.zh: 我停在你背后的黑暗里
lines.en: I stop in the dark behind you
I do not breathe, I only watch
My head leans slightly forward

lines.zh: 洞里的水滴声盖过一切
lines.en: The dripping covers everything
I wait for you to take a few more steps
My outline matches the rock
I stay motionless as if nailed down
I shift my weight onto my front foot
I count the embers of your torch

lines.zh: 我在黑暗里等很久也不会累
lines.en: Waiting in the dark never tires me
I let my arms hang at my sides
I stand beyond your firelight

lines.zh: 洞顶的阴影是我的被子
lines.en: The shadow on the cave roof is my blanket
Your eyes have landed on me
Then you should be screaming
You turned your head too fast
I could have stayed a while longer
Your eyes met mine

lines.zh: 我知道你会记住这一眼
lines.en: I know you will remember this look

lines.zh: 火把的光照到我的脸了
lines.en: The torchlight found my face
Step back, I cannot stay

lines.zh: 这一秒之后我就不在了
lines.en: After this second I am gone
I was not meant to be seen

lines.zh: 你的手在抖，火把也在抖
lines.en: Your hand shakes, and the torch with it
We only looked at each other once
You have finally turned to face me

lines.zh: 你看见了一个不该在的东西
lines.en: You saw something that should not be there
My mouth is opening
Listen, this is my voice

lines.zh: 我站在你身后已经很久
lines.en: I have stood behind you a long while
I have memorized your expression
Back away, and I scatter
That one landed on me
That made me vanish early
My scream caught in my throat
Thirty health drops too fast
My body is turning transparent
You should not have landed that
I retreat into the rock
Pain lasts seconds for me
A corner of my outline broke
I can no longer see you clearly
That is not what I eat
You turned around holding it up

lines.zh: 这挡不住我，但会让我走
lines.en: It will not stop me, but it will make me leave

lines.zh: 别用手电一样的东西照我
lines.en: Do not shine that torch-like thing at me
I am not hungry, I am only following
The moment your hand rises, I retreat

lines.zh: 这东西在黑暗里太亮了
lines.en: This thing is too bright in the dark

lines.zh: 你收起来，也许我就不叫
lines.en: Put it away and maybe I will not scream
I only wanted to watch you
Leave it down and do not turn around
You backed into me
That surprised us both
I recoil half a block at once
There is still warmth in your back
I should not have touched you
I press back against the rock

lines.zh: 我们的距离不该这么近
lines.en: Our distance should not be this close

lines.zh: 你转身的时候我已经退了
lines.en: When you turned, I had already backed off
That touch makes it impossible to stay

lines.zh: 我没有恶意，只是站错了地方
lines.en: No malice, I merely stood in the wrong place
This cave keeps only one shadow

lines.zh: 你问的东西我从来不想
lines.en: I never think about what you asked
All I know is following
I never learned that
The dark has no need for such things
My existence lasts only seconds
I shake my head and draw back
Say no more, I will vanish
I turn my face to one side
I go back to following you
I pick up what you dropped
I have no pockets on me
I hold it up and look at it

lines.zh: 这东西在黑暗里有点亮
lines.en: This thing is a little bright in the dark

lines.zh: 我拿着它，但不知道该做什么
lines.en: I hold it and do not know what to do
It slips from my fingers
I set it at your feet
Keeping this is no use to me
I touch it lightly
It lands loudly
Your steps have stopped
I should keep following
What you hold is pointed at me
I do not like this angle
Did you hear my breathing
I have fixed on your back
This position is good
The moment you turn, I close in

lines.zh: 四格的攻击距离足够了
lines.en: Four blocks of attack range is enough
Turn around soon or I come closer
You are too close
Your back is turned to me
I should not move, but I want to

lines.zh: 你手里的火把照不到我
lines.en: Your torch does not reach me
I chose you out of the dark
This sound is mine
I stay close behind you
Your torch only lights the front
There is no second path in this cave
However slowly you walk, I match it
I am waiting for your torch to burn out
Your breathing quickens
I make not a single sound
Every time you stop, I close half a block

lines.zh: 洞壁帮我把声音折回来
lines.en: The cave walls fold my sound back

lines.zh: 再往前走，你就到死角了
lines.en: A little further and you reach a dead end
I do not want to be found so soon
I follow without a sound
Your footsteps are loud in here

lines.zh: 我在等你的火把低下去
lines.en: I wait for your torch to dip
Ten more steps and you reach the end
I hug the wall you walked past
I press my breathing down to nothing

lines.zh: 你的影子盖住了我的影子
lines.en: Your shadow covers mine
I want one more look at you
I snatch from behind
This one carries only four points
My fingers graze your shoulder
You turned, and I pulled back
That was only the lightest touch
You were shoved forward
I need not hold on long
This blow is to make you run

lines.zh: 我叫了一声，你也该跑了
lines.en: I screamed once, so you should run
I scatter right after the blow
I reach out and touch your neck
This one is light as wind
I only want you to stop

lines.zh: 你被我一推就往前跑了
lines.en: One push and you ran forward

lines.zh: 我的指甲停在你衣领上
lines.en: My nails stop at your collar
This time I did not scream
You have still not turned round
The tunnel has one more breath in it
I am five blocks behind you

lines.zh: 我的眼睛先在黑暗里亮起
lines.en: My eyes light up in the dark first

lines.zh: 我一直在这里，只是刚才没动
lines.en: I was always here, I just had not moved

lines.zh: 你脚下的水洼里有我的影子
lines.en: My shadow is in the puddle at your feet
This cave has many corners

lines.zh: 我挑了一个最好的位置
lines.en: I picked the best one
I wait for you to hear me
The moment you turn, I scream
Three seconds is enough to see you clearly
I am around the corner behind you

lines.zh: 洞里多了一个人的重量
lines.en: The cave holds one more person's weight

lines.zh: 我站在你脚步的回声里
lines.en: I stand inside the echo of your steps
You have not noticed me yet
My head is tilted slightly

lines.zh: 我从洞壁的阴影里走出来
lines.en: I step out of the wall's shadow

lines.zh: 我很安静，比水声还安静
lines.en: I am quiet, quieter than the water
These blocks of dark are mine

lines.zh: 火把的光烧穿了我的形状
lines.en: The torchlight burned through my shape

lines.zh: 我从洞壁滑下去，抓不住
lines.en: I slid down the cave wall, could not grip
The cave water fills me, very stifling

lines.zh: 爆炸把洞穴的黑暗炸开一个口
lines.en: The blast tore a hole in the cave darkness

lines.zh: 飞来的东西穿过我的身体
lines.en: Something flying passed through my body

lines.zh: 那股术力在我体内亮起来
lines.en: That magic lit up inside me
I have never needed to eat

lines.zh: 雷光把岩壁照得发白，我睁不开眼
lines.en: The flash whitened the rock, I could not see

lines.zh: 我背后的黑暗变成了空
lines.en: The dark behind me turned to nothing
